_note: FL23 draft: shipped notes that the code contradicts (Gold Ship and Freejia). Every block note is a full-text replacement (the spec format has no partial edit). Apply in the apply pass (plan section 7) after a fresh extract:lt. Docs that cannot go through merge are listed in the report, section 'Contradictions'.

blockNote: Palette-phase thinker of the Gold Ship wreck scenes (Bank 00, 46705-46802). Three scene_thinkers lists spawn it (0CE87F, 0CE890, 0CE8A1) and five scenes run it: $2B (0CE87F), $2C (0CE87F+4, which skips the first record), $2D (0CE8A1), $2E (0CE8A1+8, which skips the first two records) and $2F (0CE890), all Gold Ship scenes. The flags it reads, $4D and $52, are set and cleared by dc2F_adrift (also gs2E_sleep and gs2B_erik).
=== PHASE PICK (spawn only) ===

The two flag tests run once when the thinker spawns; the loops after them never return to the tests, so the phase is fixed for the scene visit (scene $2F reloads for each adrift 'day', which re-spawns the thinker with the then-current flags). Flag $52 set: final phase. Else flag $4D set: GoldShipWreckPaletteFlag4D (bundle #34 once, then the #33 loop). Neither: default.
=== DEFAULT: bundle #1A forever ===

A 12-strip palette cycle on colours $21-$2C (palette 2, colours 1-12): each strip is a 24-byte window that slides one colour at a time (wait 2-5), the peak colour $4164 a bright blue, so a highlight travels through the 12 colours. PaletteStart + PaletteStep play all strips and BRA repeats. It reads as a water glint cycle (an inference from the colours).
=== FLAG $4D: GoldShipWreckPaletteFlag4D ===

Bundle #34 once (a one-shot: 16 colours at $70, palette 7, and one colour at $59), then the scene-setup latch $FF is set and bundle #33 (the same 12-strip cycle as #1A with other colour values) loops while $FF stays set. When the latch is cleared (next scene setup or inventory open) the thinker restarts with #34. #34 plays once per latch cycle.
=== FLAG $52: GoldShipWreckPaletteFlag52 ===

Kills the thinker at the list head ($5A) and the one in the next pool slot (+$10): the first two thinkers spawned, which are scanline_band_hdma_thinker records 0 and 1 in all three lists (pool slots are handed out in ascending order from $0F00). KillThinker works on the slot in X and uses D only for its operand pointer, so D can stay on this thinker. Then it fills palette-buffer bytes $7F0A40-$7F0A5F, colours $20-$2F (palette 2), with $1421 (very dark blue, R1 G1 B5) so the colours the cycle used stay flat, sets colour 0 ($7F0A00) to $1442, applies bundle #36 (17 colours at $50, 16 at $70), sets $FF and waits for the latch to clear before repeating the fill and #36 (the kills are not repeated).
What $4D and $52 mean in story terms (adrift day / night / starvation phase) and what the colours depict is not decoded.
Wave motion parallax controller for the Gold Ship scenes.

Placed in scenes $2B-$2F (the wreck, the ship deck, the wreck interior, the gold interior and the adrift scene). At spawn it subtracts $20 from cameraDeltaY in scenes $2D and $2E only (the test is scene >= $2D and < $2F). Each frame it adds orbitAngle to cameraDeltaY while orbitDiameter counts down, to create the visual effect of the ship bobbing on waves; in scene $2F it then copies cameraDeltaY to cameraTargetY. Uses chatPtr, orbitAngle and orbitDiameter for sinusoidal wave timing.
Ship departure sequence — the Gold Ship leaves the cave (scene $2C).

Flag $4C clear: sets the joypad lock ($EFFC), sets the word flag $0185, writes TM = $15, CGADSUB = $B1 and COLDATA = $FF, places Will at pixel (D0,20) and starts player_character.loc_02C63B on him, then tests each frame (SetEntryHere) whether Will is at (D0,240). There it sets the joypad lock again, spawns oneshot_backdrop_fade_out_1C, waits #BF, sets $4C, prints 'This is the Incan Gold Ship?!', releases the joypad lock and dies.
Flag $4C set: the actor dies at once (code_0581FD). No music command is run by this actor.
Crow's Nest guard on the Gold Ship deck (scene $2C) — brightness sequence when the ship leaves the cave.

Flag $4F set: code_058498 sets musicRoomGroup to 2 and idles. Flag $4F clear: waits for $4C (set by gs2C_descent), spawns a helper actor (code_05857A) that writes TM = $15, CGADSUB = $A1 and COLDATA = $E0 every frame and dies when $4F is set, and waits for $4F. The talk handler (code_0584A9) prints 'Oh short King, look there. The ship is coming out of the cave!' and sets $4F; later talks print the 'brightness is like a new beginning' dialog.

When $4F becomes set the script sets the joypad lock ($EFFC), starts music #03, waits one frame and calls vblank_joypad.VBlankWaitAndJoypad, blacks the backdrop colour, writes TM = $17, CGADSUB = $A2 and COLDATA = $FF, waits #3B, spawns oneshot_backdrop_fade_out_1C, waits #BF, writes CGADSUB = $22, waits #77, prints the guard's dialog, releases the joypad lock and falls into code_058498.
The Queen of the Gold Ship — key NPC of scene $2E.

Flag $4F clear: spawns a helper actor (code_058B07) that writes TM = $15 every frame and dies when $4F is set. Both paths then continue into code_058A0F: the Queen is nudged +8 in X and gets a talk handler. First talk (flag $4E clear): the long welcome dialog (the Mystic Statue of the Wind, the Incan royal family backstory) and sets $4E; later talks print dialogstring_058A30+M.
Central character in the Gold Ship's backstory about the Incan royal family.
Bed of the Gold Ship (scene $2E) — trigger of the Shira dream.

The actor is solid with a talk handler: flag $4E clear or $4F clear gives 'Looking around the ship? ... rest in this bed'; $4E, $4F and $F8 all set gives 'try to get some rest'; $4E and $4F set with $F8 clear gives the first line again. The script waits for $4E and $4F, sets musicRoomGroup to 2 and then tests $F8 each frame (set by the Mystic Statue ceremony of scene $FD). With $F8 set it tests each frame whether Will stands on tiles (0B,04)-(0C,06). Then it sets the joypad lock ($CFFC), prints 'I fell into a deep sleep...', holds Will in player_transition_handlers.PlayerPoseHold 8 pixels higher, waits #3B, sets $4D, sets musicRoomGroup to 0 and queues scene $2A (the dream with gs2A_shira). No form change is made in this file.
Thinker of the Shira dream (scene $2A) — palette animation #35.

Loops PaletteStart #35 plus PaletteStep, then sets the scene-setup latch $FF and waits until $FF is cleared outside this block (WaitOnFlagByte(#FF, #00)), then branches back to the start. The loop has no exit in this block; the KillThinker at loc_00B6E2 is not reached from it.
Camera zoom controller for Will's dream about his mother (scene $2A).

Waits for scratch flag $0E (set by gs2A_shira in its talk handler). Then it writes $00F6 = $0088 minus bg1ScrollH and $00FA = $0180 minus mapScrollV, starts $00FE at $00A0, lowers $00FE by 2 each frame and dies when $00FE is below $0040.
Adrift at sea — multi-day starvation sequence after the ship is set adrift.
The longest cutscene script in the game (~608 lines). Covers the
crew's days of drifting: day-by-day text transitions, starvation
mechanics that damage the player's HP, enemy stat changes for
the weakening crew, palette fades to represent passing time,
and the eventual rescue. Uses hpToHeal for visual HP
drain effects. Includes
player_transition_handlers for cutscene movement control.
Lilly in the wrecked Gold Ship interior (scene $2D) — wakes Will, then reacts to the Queen's ring.

Flag $50 clear (first visit): sets $50, sets the joypad lock ($CFFC), holds Will in player_transition_handlers.PlayerPoseHold, waits #1D, prints 'Will! Wake up!', waits #3B, returns Will to player_character.PlayerIdleEntry, releases the joypad lock ($EFFC) and falls into code_058CFF. Flag $50 set: starts at code_058CFF.

code_058CFF: waits for scratch flag $01 (set by gs2D_mummy's first talk), is placed at tile (1D,0D) and walks, waits for scratch flag $02 (set by gs2D_mummy's dialog), prints the ring dialog, starts music #1B, shakes the camera three times with camera_drift (CameraDriftLoopShip), prints Kara's 'What?', starts music #06, sets musicRoomGroup to 1, installs the talk handler code_058DB6 and releases the joypad lock ($EFFC). From then on each frame it tests RngByte AND $E0 and, when the result is not zero, stores it in $08 and spawns another camera shake. The talk handler before the ring dialog is code_058DB1.
Lance in the wrecked Gold Ship interior (scene $2D) — triggers the Seth cutscene on approach.

Before scratch flag $01 (set by gs2D_mummy's first talk): solid NPC at its spawn tile with the talk handler code_059028. After flag $01: clears the solid mark, moves to tile (0F,0D) (frame #05) and tests each frame whether Will is within 3 tiles (BranchIfPlayerNear). When Will is near it sets the joypad lock ($EFFC), prints 'Are you OK?', waits #3B, shakes the camera with camera_drift (CameraDriftLoopShip), waits #B3, prints Seth's scream with Lance's reply, sets persistent flag $51, removes the talk handler, walks off, releases the joypad lock and dies.
Kara in the wrecked Gold Ship interior (scene $2D).

Solid NPC with two talk handlers, switched by scratch flag $02 (set by gs2D_mummy's dialog): before it she says 'They perished waiting for the King's return...'; after it she says only 'What . . . ?'.
Locked door in Freejia (scene $32).

Solid door actor. It tests no flag and applies no background change. At spawn, when Will is within #01 tile (BranchIfPlayerNear), it shows frame #00, sets the joypad lock ($CFFC) for #1D ticks and plays sound #0E; then (and otherwise at once) it shows frame #01, marks itself solid and sets the talk handler, which always prints 'It's locked from the inside...'.
Guard blocking the Freejia back alley (scene $32).

Solid actor with a talk handler. The handler compares playerXPos ($09A2) with the guard's own X position ($14): below it prints 'Children don't come here. Go home.'; at or above it prints 'This kid! Where did you come from?! Go home! Go home!!' and sets scratch flag $01, on which the guard's main script clears its solid mark, writes $FFFB to playerSpeedEw ($09B2), waits #1D, clears the flag and marks itself solid again. No story flag is tested.
Hotel guide man in Freejia (scene $32) — leads Will and Kara to the hotel.

Flag $57 clear: spawns the door actor code_05B315 (it opens on scratch flag $05). With $64 clear the guide waits for scratch $02 (set by fr32_kara), walks (StageSpriteLoopMove), prints 'What a cute couple... Have you decided where you're staying tonight?', clears $02, waits for scratch $03, walks to the hotel door and falls into code_05B1F1, where it stands at tile (28,25) with the talk line 'Well, come in.'; with $64 set it starts at code_05B1F1. Flag $57 set: stands at tile (29,24) with the 'Business is terrible' line and spawns town_door.TownDoorInit. The guide sets no flag.
Door of the back-street house where Erik is held (scene $32, from Sam's dialog) and the voice behind it.

First-phase actor (code_05B371): flag $67 set -> dies. Otherwise marks tile (04,0D) solid, waits while off-screen and, when Will enters tiles (05,0E)-(0B,12), moves its sprite, spawns the door actor code_05B3A1 at pixel (0048,00E0) and dies. The door actor is a solid door sprite (spriteset_npc_props frame #01) with a talk handler: flag $66 (Sam told Will) clear prints 'Man's voice: If you don't want to lose your lives, go home!!'; $66 set prints the same line plus Will asking about Erik, sets $67 and marks tiles (08,0E)-(08,11) solid. Once $67 is set the door actor copies palette data, sets joypad mask bit $2000, clears playerFlags bit $0008, calls EnemyInitBasic with HP 5, sets bit $0100 and clears bit $1000 of $10, and prints 'If I don't save Erik...' while Will stands on tiles (07,0E)-(08,12). What a hit does afterwards is the common enemy code, not read here.
Boyfriend NPC in the Adequacy Manor — caught in a comic scene.
NPC with a single talk line (no flag test). Says: "She, uh, was just helping
me... Ha ha ha." Part of the couple joke sequence with the
girlfriend NPC.
Slave market guard (scene $3C).

Solid guard with a talk handler: prints 'Hey, boy! Kids can't come here! Go home! Go home! Or did you come to get a laborer?' with a Yes/No choice. No (or cancel) prints 'Go home! Go home!'. Yes prints 'I like your courage! I don't know what you'd do here, but have a look around.' and sets scratch flag $01; the main script then clears its solid mark, steps aside (StageSpriteMoveX) and shows frame #1A. No story flag is tested.

UseItem_MemoryMelody: Memory Melody — play in the Freejia hotel (scene $39, Lance's room).

Third melody handler. Requires Will (form 0) and scene $39 with flag $68 clear (Lance's memory is not restored yet). Checks tile region ($13,$18)–($1A,$1D). Music track $1D, melody index 2. Unlike the other melodies, this handler does not use the shared UseItem_FluteConfigureController subroutine — it configures the music actor inline and additionally sets musicParentActor to $0E.
UseItem_MemoryMelody_Effect: Memory Melody success (melody index 2 of the flute effect table) — removes item $0D, spawns a palette reset thinker and sets scratch flag $0F. In scene $39 fr39_lance waits for $0F, clears it and later sets $68.
